annotations.text:
Instrument panel, not dashboard.

No cards anywhere - sections are separated by hairline rules and air, like a spec sheet. All measurements set in tabular monospace so columns do not shift as values update. One accent, amber, used ONLY on things changing right now: the live IPS trace, the brawler being pushed, a running tracker. Everything static is greyscale.
The hairline across the header is the loop's real frame rate, one pixel tall. It is data, not ornament - flat means idle. It is also the only thing on the page that moves.
